entities.summary: Michelle Anne Panter, known as Anne Panter or Ann Panter, is an English field hockey international, who was a member of the England and Great Britain women's field hockey team since 2002. She competed for Great Britain at the 2008 Summer Olympics and was part of the bronze medal-winning team at the 2012 Summer Olympics.
